 Hon'Ble Harvir Singh, J. 
1.
Heard learned counsel for the revisionist and learned AGA for the State.
None is present on behalf of opposite party no. 2 despite being served.

2. By means of the present revision, the revisionist has challenged the order dated 29.5.2023 passed by the A. C. J. M.-Ist, Muzaffar Nagar in Case No. 1135/9 of 2018 (State Versus Subey Singh and others) under Sections 504, 323, 506 IPC, arising out of Case Crime No. 1395 of 2017, under Sections-376, 511, 392, 323 and 506 IPC, P. S.-Nai Mandi, district-Muzaffar Nagar, by which the discharge application filed by the revisionist has been dismissed.
3.

entities.text: A. C. J. M.-Ist, Muzaffar Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the revisionist submits that initially an F. I. R. was lodged under Sections 376, 511, 392, 323 and 506 IPC, however, the charge-sheet was filed against the revisionist under Sections-323, 504 and 506 IPC.
Learned counsel also submits that the discharge application has been dismissed in a cursory manner, as no sufficient material was on record, on the basis of which,
charge
can be framed against the revisionist.

4. Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that the Investigating Officer after conducting a fair and impartial investigation has filed charge-sheet under Sections-323, 504 and 506 IPC and further submits that at the stage of framing of charge, only prima facie case is to be seen and each and every aspect of the evidence cannot be discussed in detail, therefore, rejection of discharge application is in accordance with law and prays that no interference be called for by this Court in the order dated 29.5.2023 passed by learned ACJM-Ist, Muzaffar Nagar.

5. Having heard rival contentions and perusal of the order dated 29.5.2023 reveals that at the stage of charge, whether it is an application for discharge or simultaneously framing charge against an accused, the learned trial court has to see, whether a prima facie case has been made out or not.
In the present case though the first information report was lodged under Sections 376, 511, 392, 323 and 506 IPC.

However, after investigation charge-sheet has been filed under Sections 323, 504 and 506 IPC only and therefore, prima facie case is made out for framing charge against the accused persons, hence there appears to be no infirmity or irregularity in the impugned order dated 29.5.2023.
6.
The revision is devoid of merits and is accordingly dismissed.
(Harvir Singh,J.) October 7, 2025 HR
